name: Avantyury bomzha Porfiriya v pionerlagere "Sovyonok", ili kak sobirat butylki
original_name: Авантюры бомжа Порфирия в пионерлагере "Совёнок", или как собирать бутылки
source: The homeless man Porfiry Ignatyevich is just living his life: fighting with cops, sitting in the holding cell, sleeping in the subway, and returning empty bottles for deposit. But one day, fate led him onto a certain bus...
translation: The homeless man Porfiry Ignatyevich is just living his life: fighting with cops, sitting in the holding cell, sleeping in the subway, and returning empty bottles for deposit. But one day, fate led him onto a certain bus...
